about: Own-words reads from the daily research task (ADMIS, Rabobank, Czapp and the news feed). fund_score: -1 bearish to +1 bullish, a judgement on the fundamental news only.

corn.fundamental: New: Iowa harvest still well behind normal after a frost ended the season, but the national harvest is near done. Dec gave back Tuesday's wheat-led gains overnight and sits just under 443.5 support.
events: Iowa corn harvest 84% vs 95% normal (Brownfield)
Livestock expansion competing for 2027 corn acres (Brownfield)
Dec ~443 (-3.75), below 443.5 support (CBOT via TradingView)

events: Record October NOPA crush (Barchart, American Ag Network)
Trump's Asia talks put China soybean purchases in focus (AgroLatam)
Jan ~1,219.25 (-6.25) overnight (CBOT via TradingView)

events: Dec ~337.9 (+2.7) while soyoil falls (CBOT via TradingView)
Record October NOPA crush (NOPA, Barchart)

oil.fundamental: Soyoil keeps tracking crude lower and has broken the 61.34 support; nothing new on biofuel policy, so the move is energy-led rather than a change in soy demand.
events: Dec ~61.18 (-0.95), below 61.34 support (CBOT via TradingView)
Crude lower again on surplus expectations and US stock builds (Dow Jones)
Record October NOPA crush keeps oil supply ample (NOPA, Barchart)

wheat.fundamental: The Black Sea strike premium has faded; US winter wheat is nearly all planted and rated well, so supply comfort is unchanged.
events: Dec ~587.75 (-7.5), below 590 (CBOT via TradingView)
Winter wheat planting reaches 92% with four states finished (USDA, AgroLatam)

kc.fundamental: HRW gives back the Black Sea premium too; the Plains crop is off to a strong start, which keeps the supply side heavy.
events: Plains wheat crop off to a strong start (Brownfield)
Black Sea strike rally fades overnight (Barchart)

cotton.fundamental: Nothing new on US or Brazil supply this morning; Dec has slipped back under the 77.05 support into first-notice week, so old-crop Dec/Mar spread and certificate flow drive price, and high-grade certs remain a delivery risk for Dec longs rather than a comfort.
events: Dec ~76.95 (-0.37), below 77.05 support; low 76.84 (ICE via TradingView)
Crude slides again on surplus talk and inventory builds, a soft lead for polyester (Dow Jones, OilPrice.com)
Real still under pressure from fiscal worries (Bloomberg)

events: Hogs fall on weak cash and cutout (Barchart)
Swine producers entering a down market (National Hog Farmer)
Dec ~53.10 (-2.25), low 52.825, new 52-week low (CME via TradingView)

cattle.fundamental: Feedlot losses above $500/head against rebounding packer margins and Tyson's added Texas capacity point to firmer packer demand; screwworm spreading in the Southwest is the supply wild card. Cattle on Feed due Friday.
events: Feedlot losses top $500/head as packer margins rebound (Drovers)
Tyson adds Texas beef capacity via Allied Beef deal (Farm Progress)
New World screwworm spreading across southwestern states (Successful Farming)

feeders.fundamental: Screwworm spread keeps feeder supply tight, but heavy feedlot losses cap what feeders can pay; Jan slipped overnight.
events: Screwworm spreading across southwestern states (Successful Farming)
Feedlot losses top $500/head (Drovers)
Jan feeders ~328.2 (-4.9) (CME via TradingView)

CME spot mixed; butter and NFDM firmer (Brownfield)

events: CME spot butter and NFDM higher Tuesday (Brownfield)
